root_cause: The C-after archive generator mixed declared expected outcomes with actual execution evidence: it hardcoded phase-gate exit codes, the unittest count and exit code, the pre-cutoff replay HOLD result, and operational-tree hashes into the pending manifest instead of consuming a separately recorded execution observation.
risk: A pending manifest could claim a successful validation even when the observed suite or replay differed; Reviewer1's earlier observed-count mismatch demonstrated that this was not merely theoretical.
corrective_action: Require a governance-side validator to execute the fixed commands, preserve exact stdout and stderr bytes, mechanically re-derive every result, compare scheduler and repository state before and after, commit a fail-closed record and sidecar, and make the new C-after archive bind and project that record without result constants.
scope_boundary: This incident and repair concern Phase-0 evidence authenticity only. They do not change the frozen data-feasibility decision surface, observation schedule, lottery data, model design, or Stage-1 implementation scope.
